title: Realtime voice gets a WebSocket API
summary:
Realtime voice, new StepFun and Perplexity options, and Claude Opus 4.8 made this a model-heavy day; frequently accessed media got a longer lease on life.

Added an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/realtime` endpoint for `gpt-realtime-2`, supporting text and audio input and output in live sessions. The model also appears in the model catalogue. Input transcription sessions are not supported yet.

Added StepFun Step 3.7 Flash with vision and tools, plus the text-only Step 3.5 Flash with reasoning and tools. The Perplexity lineup gained Sonar Pro and a broader-context search option, with search-context defaults adjusted across the lineup.

Added paid-only Claude Opus 4.8 with text and image input, tools, and a 1M-token context window. Its Bedrock route and pricing were updated, while Claude usage now distinguishes cache creation from cache reads; the new usage fields were documented.

highlights.title: Realtime voice sessions
highlights.text: Use `/v1/realtime` over WebSocket for live text and audio sessions with `gpt-realtime-2`. Input transcription sessions are not supported yet. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-realtime-2).

highlights.title: Step 3.7 Flash
highlights.text: Try `step-flash` with text and vision input, reasoning, and tool use. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=step-flash).

highlights.title: Sonar Pro search
highlights.text: Use `perplexity` for Sonar Pro search through the text API. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=perplexity).

highlights.title: Broader-context Sonar search
highlights.text: Use `perplexity-deep` when you want Sonar search with broader search context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=perplexity-deep).

highlights.title: Claude Opus 4.8
highlights.text: Claude Opus 4.8 supports text and image input, tools, and a 1M-token context window. It requires a paid balance. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Step 3.5 Flash
highlights.text: Use `step-3.5-flash` for text tasks with reasoning, tool use, and a 262,144-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=step-3.5-flash).
